topic: Bernoulli, Binomial, Geometric, Poisson, and Other Discrete Random Variables
title: Two Blue Parts Draft
prompt: A bin contains 7 blue parts and 5 silver parts. Four parts are selected without replacement. What is the probability that exactly 2 selected parts are blue?
hints: Because selection is without replacement, use combinations rather than a binomial model.
Choose the requested successes and the remaining draws from the other group.
solutionSteps: Choose 2 of the 7 target objects and 2 of the 5 other objects.

misconceptions.feedback: Selections without replacement are dependent, so a fixed-p binomial calculation is not appropriate.
